Loki findet heraus, was die Variante vorhat, aber er hat seine eigenen Pläne.

Die Uhr tickt im Staffelfinale, in dem Loki und Sylvie ein Rendezvous mit dem Schicksal haben.
Ein aus der Zeit gelöster Loki wird zwischen Vergangenheit, Gegenwart und Zukunft herumgezerrt.
Am Rande eines temporalen Zusammenbruchs versuchen Loki und Mobius alles, um Sylvie zu finden.
Um die TVA zu retten, machen sich Loki und Mobius auf die Suche nach einer abtrünnigen Cartoon-Uhr.
Eine Katastrophe steht bevor, doch Loki, Mobius und Sylvie haben eine Variante von Jenem Der Bleibt.
Loki sucht in sterbenden Zeitstrahlen nach seinen Freunden, doch nichts ist, wie es scheint.
Loki erkennt die wahre Natur seines "glorreichen Ansinnens" und ändert die Vergangenheit.
After stealing the Tesseract in "Avengers: Endgame," Loki lands before the Time Variance Authority.
Mobius puts Loki to work, but not everyone at TVA is thrilled about the God of Mischief's presence.
Loki finds out The Variant's plans, but he has his own that will forever alter both their destinies.
Frayed nerves and paranoia infiltrate the TVA as Mobius and Hunter B-15 search for Loki and Sylvie.
Loki tries to escape The Void, a desolate purgatory where he meets variant versions of himself.

Loki finds himself lost to time and torn, quite literally, between past, present and future.
With the TVA on the verge of a temporal meltdown, Loki & Mobius will stop at nothing to find Sylvie.
Loki & Mobius go on the hunt to find everyone’s favorite cartoon clock as they try to save the TVA.
The TVA's Loom nears catastrophic failure but Loki, Mobius and Sylvie have a He Who Remains variant.
Loki traverses dying timelines in an attempt to find his friends, but Reality is not what it seems.
Loki learns the true nature of 'glorious purpose' as he rectifies the past.

eps.n: Was wäre, wenn Captain Carter die Erste der Avengers geworden wäre?
eps.o: Steve Rogers wird schwer verletzt, woraufhin Peggy Carter zur ersten Supersoldatin der Welt wird.

eps.n: Was wäre, wenn T'Challa zu Star Lord geworden wäre?
eps.o: Die als „Ravagers“ bekannten Weltraumpiraten entführen statt Peter Quill den jungen T'Challa.

eps.n: Was wäre, wenn die Welt ihre mächtigsten Helden verloren hätte?
eps.o: Nick Fury will die Avengers versammeln, doch diese werden von einem Serienmörder heimgesucht.

eps.n: Was wäre, wenn Doctor Strange statt seiner Hände sein Herz verloren hätte?
eps.o: Ein untröstlicher Doctor Strange benutzt das Auge von Agamotto, um die Vergangenheit zu ändern.
Die Avengers werden mit einer Zombie-Seuche infiziert und die übrigen Helden suchen ein Heilmittel.

eps.n: Was wäre, wenn Killmonger Tony Stark gerettet hätte?
eps.o: Ein Soldat namens Killmonger rettet Tony Stark, als dessen Konvoi in Afghanistan angegriffen wird.

eps.n: Was wäre, wenn Thor ein Einzelkind gewesen wäre?
eps.o: Ein Thor, der nie lernte, ein guter Held zu sein, schmeißt auf der Erde eine intergalaktische Party.

eps.n: Was wäre, wenn Ultron gewonnen hätte?
eps.o: Nach einer schlimmen Katastrophe müssen Natasha und Clint den tödlichen Roboter Ultron vernichten.

eps.n: Was wäre, wenn der Watcher seinen Schwur gebrochen hätte?
eps.o: Was wäre, wenn der Watcher seinen Schwur gebrochen hätte?

eps.n: Was wäre, wenn Nebula für das Nova Corps rekrutiert worden wäre?
eps.o: Als Nebula für das Nova Corps rekrutiert wird, will sie sich als Ermittlerin beweisen.

eps.n: Was wäre, wenn Peter Quill die mächtigsten Helden der Erde angegriffen hätte?
eps.o: 1988 bedrohen Ego und der junge Peter Quill die Erde. Howard Stark und Peggy Carter formen ein Team.

eps.n: Was wäre, wenn Happy Hogan Weihnachten gerettet hätte?
eps.o: Der Avengers-Tower wird während der Weihnachtsfeier angegriffen und nur Happy Hogan kann helfen.

eps.n: Was wäre, wenn Iron Man auf den Grandmaster treffen würde?
eps.o: Tony Stark fordert den Grandmaster heraus und es kommt zu einem Grand-Prix-Todesrennen.

eps.n: Was wäre, wenn Captain Carter den Hydra-Stampfer besiegt hätte?
eps.o: Captain Carters Mission zur Rettung von Steve Rogers führt sie auf Kollisionskurs mit neuen Feinden.

eps.n: Was wäre, wenn Kahhori die Welt umformen würde?
eps.o: Eine junge Mohawk reist in die Gewässer des Verbotenen Sees, um ihr Volk zu retten.

eps.n: Was wäre, wenn Hela die Zehn Ringe gefunden hätte?
eps.o: Hela—ohne Kräfte und auf die Erde verbannt—stößt auf eine neue Quelle der Macht: die Zehn Ringe.

eps.n: Was wäre, wenn die Avengers im Jahr 1602 zusammenkämen?
eps.o: Captain Carter hat es mit einer Anomalie zu tun, die Helden und Schurken ins Jahr 1602 versetzt.

eps.n: Was wäre, wenn Strange Supreme einschreiten würde?
eps.o: Captain Carter erkennt, dass die größte Bedrohung für alle Existenz ihr näher steht als vermutet.

eps.n: Was wäre, wenn Hulk die Mech-Avengers besiegt hätte?
eps.o: Das neue Mech-Avengers-Team stellt sich einem versehentlich weiterentwickelten Hulk.

eps.n: Was wäre, wenn Agatha nach Hollywood gegangen wäre?
eps.o: Hollywood Filmstar Agatha Harkness bekommt in Howard Starks erster Produktion einen Gegenspieler.

eps.n: Was wäre, wenn Red Guardian den Winter Soldier aufgehalten hätte?
eps.o: Der Red Guardian vereitelt die Mission des Winter Soldiers, Howard Stark zu töten.

eps.n: Was wäre, wenn die Ente Howard verheiratet wäre?
eps.o: Die Ente Howard und Darcy Lewis stellen sich gefährlichen Mächten der Galaxie - und das im Urlaub!

eps.n: Was wäre, wenn die Emergenz die Erde zerstört hätte?
eps.o: Riri Williams macht sich in einer tödlichen Mission auf, um den Diktator Quentin Beck zu stürzen.
Der legendäre Shang-Chi und Kate Bishop suchen im Wilden Westen nach The Hood.

eps.n: Was wäre, wenn der Watcher verschwinden würde?
eps.o: Der Watcher wird für sein Eingreifen zur Rechenschaft gezogen.
Das Ende des Anfangs...

eps.n: What If... Captain Carter Were the First Avenger?
eps.o: When Steve Rogers is seriously injured, Peggy Carter becomes the world’s first Super Soldier.

eps.n: What If... T'Challa Became a Star-Lord?
eps.o: The rough-and-tumble space pirates known as the Ravagers abduct T’Challa instead of Peter Quill.

eps.n: What If... The World Lost Its Mightiest Heroes?
eps.o: Nick Fury struggles to launch The Avengers when candidates are targeted by a serial killer.

eps.n: What If... Doctor Strange Lost His Heart Instead of His Hands?
eps.o: A grief-stricken Doctor Strange uses the Eye of Agamotto in a dangerous effort to change the past.
When The Avengers are infected by a zombie plague, surviving heroes search for a cure.

eps.n: What If... Killmonger Rescued Tony Stark?
eps.o: An American soldier called Killmonger rescues Tony Stark when his Humvee is attacked in Afghanistan.

eps.n: What If... Thor Were an Only Child?
eps.o: Thor, who never learned to be a good hero, throws an out-of-control intergalactic party on Earth.
Natasha Romanoff and Clint Barton seek to destroy killer-robot Ultron following a cataclysmic event.

eps.n: What If... The Watcher Broke His Oath?
eps.o: The Watcher breaks his oath and recruits heroes from across the multiverse to battle against Ultron.

eps.n: What If... Nebula Joined the Nova Corps?
eps.o: When Nebula is recruited to join the Nova Corps, she sets out to prove her detective skills.

eps.n: What If... Peter Quill Attacked Earth's Mightiest Heroes?
eps.o: When Ego and a young Peter Quill threaten Earth in 1988, Howard Stark and Peggy Carter form a team.

eps.n: What If... Happy Hogan Saved Christmas?
eps.o: When Avengers Tower is attacked during the holiday party, Happy Hogan must prove his hero chops.

eps.n: What If... Iron Man Crashed Into the Grandmaster?
eps.o: Tony Stark challenges The Grandmaster, leading to a grand prix-turned-demolition-derby death match.

eps.n: What If... Captain Carter Fought the Hydra Stomper?
eps.o: Captain Carter's mission to save Steve Rogers sets her on a collision course with new enemies.

eps.n: What If... Kahhori Reshaped the World?
eps.o: A Mohawk woman ventures into the waters of the Forbidden Lake to help save her people.

eps.n: What If... Hela Found the Ten Rings?
eps.o: Hela—stripped of her powers and banished to Earth—comes across a new source of power: the Ten Rings.

eps.n: What If... The Avengers Assembled in 1602?
eps.o: Captain Carter tries to undo the anomaly that strands familiar heroes and villains in the year 1602.
Captain Carter discovers the greatest threat to all existence may be closer than she realizes.

eps.n: What If... The Hulk Fought the Mech Avengers?
eps.o: Captain America/Sam Wilson must suit up in a colossal mech suit to battle Bruce Banner after an attempt to cure himself of the Hulk goes horribly wrong. Bucky Barnes, Monica Rambeau, Moon Knight, and others must join Sam as his new team of Mech Avengers.

eps.n: What If... Agatha Went to Hollywood?
eps.o: On the set of Stark Pictures' first production, the playboy auteur quickly finds himself enchanted by his bewitching lead actress, Agatha Harkness. Little does she know there will be another superpower co-star on the call sheet… Kingo.

eps.n: What If... The Red Guardian Stopped the Winter Soldier?
eps.o: It is 1991, and the Red Guardian takes it upon himself to join a high-profile mission and prove himself to his Red Room superiors. When his antics interfere with the Winter Soldier's own mission to kill Howard Stark, the two Soviet supersoldiers must form an alliance to escape the United States.

eps.n: What If... Howard the Duck Got Hitched?
eps.o: Howard the Duck and Darcy Lewis find themselves on an intergalactic pleasure cruise. When dangerous factions from across the galaxy descend to threaten their trip, they must discover their own cosmic powers to withstand the onslaught.

eps.n: What If... The Emergence Destroyed the Earth?
eps.o: In a Universe where The Eternals never stopped The Emergence, the birth of an incubating Celestial shatters the Earth. Civilization endures on the rocky remnants of our planet, where Quentin Beck leads an authoritarian regime until freedom fighters recruit Riri Williams on a deadly mission to take h
In a universe where the heroes of the MCU live in the Old West, Shang-Chi and his pistol-packing partner, Kate Bishop, traverse the frontier, saving the innocent from the evils of The Hood.
The Watcher must stand trial for his many interventions.
The end of the beginning...

eps.o: Murdocks Kampf für Gerechtigkeit bei Nacht und seine neue Anwaltskanzlei werden durch einen neuen Mordfall gleichermaßen mit gefährlichen Herausforderungen konfrontiert.
Bei dem Versuch, einen entführten Jungen zu retten, unterläuft Murdock ein beinahe tödlicher Fehler. Doch plötzlich findet er eine überraschende Verbündete.
Murdock und Foggy nehmen sich eines geheimnisvollen, wohlhabenden Klienten an, doch Murdock ist überzeugt, dass sich hinter dem Fall mehr verbirgt als nur die Fakten.
Ein böses Brüderpaar aus Russland versetzt Daredevil im Auftrag von Fisk einen Schlag. Fisk versucht, seine Machtposition in der kriminellen Unterwelt weiter zu festigen.
Fisk setzt seine Pläne fort, die Hell's Kitchen auseinanderzureißen drohen. Murdock und Foggy versuchen indes, den schikanierten Mietern eines Elendsviertels zu helfen.
Daredevil ist in den negativen Konsequenzen von Fisks Plan zur Übernahme von Hell's Kitchen gefangen. Ben Urich kommt der Wahrheit indes allmählich näher.
Eine wichtige Person aus Murdocks Vergangenheit taucht wieder auf und bittet ihn um Hilfe im Kampf gegen einen neuen Feind, der Hell's Kitchen bedroht.
Während die Mission von Murdock, Foggy und Karen allmählich Form annimmt, gerät Fisks Welt bei seinem Kampf um Hell's Kitchen zunehmend außer Kontrolle.
Fisk gewinnt die Oberhand, was es nun noch schwerer macht, ihn zu zerstören. Daredevil hat indes mit seinen eigenen Dämonen zu kämpfen.
Die Beziehung zwischen Murdock und Foggy wird auf die ultimative Probe gestellt. Indes taucht ein neuer Feind von Fisk auf.
Fisk und Murdock haben mit den Folgen ihrer Entscheidungen zu kämpfen. Ben und Karen kommen indes Fisks wahrer Vergangenheit auf die Spur.
Fisk schwört Rache und Karen lassen die jüngsten Ereignisse nicht mehr los. Daredevil macht indes eine verblüffende Entdeckung über Fisk.
In der letzten Folge der 1. Staffel erwartet Fisk, den verzweifelten Murdock sowie Foggy und Karen die Stunde der Wahrheit.
Nach Fisks Beseitigung wird Hell's Kitchen von einer neuen Bedrohung heimgesucht. Murdock und Foggy widmen sich einem Klienten mit fragwürdiger Vergangenheit.
Während sich Murdock von einem Angriff erholt, versuchen Foggy und Karen mit allen Mitteln, ihren neuen Klienten vor dem Gesetz und dem „Punisher“ zu beschützen.
Daredevil ist dem Punisher in die Falle gegangen und hadert mit der Frage, ob Selbstjustiz moralisch vertretbar ist. Foggy und Karen versuchen, die Kanzlei zu retten.
Karen enthüllt schockierende Fakten über den Punisher, der in Hell's Kitchen jedoch selbst von gefährlichen Kräften verfolgt wird. Daredevil plant die nächsten Schritte.
Eine ehemalige Geliebte von Murdock kehrt nach Hell's Kitchen zurück und stellt sein Leben auf den Kopf. Karen will unbedingt die Wahrheit über den Punisher erfahren.
Ein tödlicher Feind mit Rachegelüsten kehrt zurück, Foggy und Murdock riskieren für die Gerechtigkeit die Kanzlei, und Karen lernt eine neue Seite des Punishers kennen.
Murdock und Foggy nehmen es im Jahrhundertprozess mit dem Staatsanwalt auf, doch ihr Klient verweigert die Kooperation. Murdock hat mit seinem Doppelleben zu kämpfen.
Während der Prozess der Kanzlei außer Kontrolle gerät, kehrt jemand aus Murdocks Vergangenheit mit schockierenden Enthüllungen über die Zukunft von Hell's Kitchen zurück.
Castle erhält ein unwiderstehliches Angebot. Foggy und Murdock zweifeln an der Zukunft ihrer Kanzlei, doch Karen gibt nicht so schnell auf.
Murdock und Foggy geraten ins Kreuzfeuer von Frank Castles Rachefeldzug. Karen und Murdock wollen - jeder auf seine Weise - die Wahrheit ergründen.
Während der Punisher seinen Rachefeldzug fortführt, steigt auch die Zahl der Toten in Hell's Kitchen. Murdock versucht, die Arbeit des Staatsanwalts zu Ende zu bringen.

eps.n: Das Dunkle am Ende des Tunnels
eps.o: Um einen alten Freund zu retten, taucht Daredevil ab. Karen verfolgt eine gefährliche Spur. Die Tage der Anwaltskanzlei Nelson & Murdock scheinen gezählt zu sein.

eps.n: Ein kalter Tag in Hell's Kitchen
eps.o: Daredevil muss einen alles entscheidenden Kampf um sein eigenes Überleben und die Zukunft von Hell's Kitchen bestreiten.
Körperlich und seelisch am Ende fragt sich Matt, wo in Hell’s Kitchen sein Platz ist. Fisk setzt unterdessen vom Gefängnis aus einen Plan in Gang.
Matt steckt in einer Glaubenskrise und trauert dem Leben nach, das er hinter sich ließ. Fisk macht mit dem FBI einen Deal, durch den er allerdings selbst zum Ziel wird.
Fisk wird unter dem Aufschrei der Öffentlichkeit in eine protzige Unterkunft verlegt. Matt ist sich unsicher, wie weit er gehen soll. Dex’ Ziel wird deutlich.
Während Matt in ein Gefängnis eindringt, um mehr über die Albaner herauszufinden, nimmt Fisk Dex ins Visier. Foggy hat es derweil satt und geht in die Offensive.
Um die heftigen Reaktionen auf seine Freilassung zu bändigen, dient Fisk dem FBI als Sündenbock. Als Dex eine Frau aus seiner Vergangenheit trifft, verfehlt er sein Ziel.
Dex ist am Ende und völlig aus der Bahn, bis Fisk ihm einen Ausweg anbietet. Matt bittet Karen um Hilfe, die sie ihm zugesteht – unter einer Bedingung.
Nach dem Angriff auf den Bulletin stellt die Presse Daredevil an den Pranger. Agent Nadeem befürchtet, dass das FBI Fisks Kooperation zu teuer erkauft hat.
Ein verzweifelter Dex sucht Hilfe und Matt geht mit mulmigem Gefühl ein Bündnis mit Agent Nadeem ein. Karen will mit einem gefährlichen Plan Fisk provozieren.
Matts bereits brüchige Welt stürzt völlig ein, als er eine schockierende Wahrheit erfährt. Karen läuft um ihr Leben. Nadeem erkennt, wie weit Fisks Einfluss reicht.
Auf der Flucht vor Fisk und Fehlern aus ihrer Vergangenheit sucht Karen bei der Kirche Zuflucht. Matt erhält endlich seine Chance und Dex holt zum tödlichen Schlag aus.
Dex will den längeren Atem haben. Nadeems Gewissen meldet sich. Fisk versucht, an ein Geschenk von Vanessa zu kommen, das bei seiner Inhaftierung beschlagnahmt wurde.
Fisks lang ersehntes Wiedersehen verläuft anders als geplant. Nelson & Murdock übernehmen einen neuen Mandanten, der wichtige Informationen zum Kingpin hat.
Während Dex immer gefährlicher wird und Fisk zum Endspiel ansetzt, muss sich Matt im Staffelfinale darauf einstellen, gewisse Grenzen zu überschreiten.

After the events of The Avengers, S.H.I.E.L.D. Agent Phil Coulson assembles a small team of agents to investigate a mysterious group called the Rising Tide. In doing so, they encounter Mike Peterson, a man who has acquired superhuman powers.

Coulson and his S.H.I.E.L.D. agents travel to Peru to investigate an object of unknown origin, codenamed 0-8-4. But when he runs into Comandante Camilla Reyes, more than just sparks fly at 30,000 feet.

When the brilliant scientist, Dr. Franklin Hall, is kidnapped, Agent Coulson and his S.H.I.E.L.D. agents must race against the clock to locate him. Skye is their only way in–pushing the team to their limits when the entire plan turns upside-down.

Agent Coulson and the S.H.I.E.L.D. team try to track down a mysterious woman who has single-handedly committed numerous high-stakes heists. But when the woman’s identity is revealed, a troubling secret stands to ruin Coulson.

An elusive girl in a flower dress may hold the key to the mystery that brings Coulson and team to Asia to rescue a young man with an unusual and dangerous power; and Skye has a secret that jeopardizes her relationship with the team right when they need her most.
When floating bodies turn up, Coulson and the agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. must hunt down an elusive killer. No one is safe - not even the team.
Dangerous secrets are being kept from Coulson's Team, and he works the system to save Ward and Fitz when they are sent on a Level 8 classified mission that may end in tragedy.

In the aftermath of the events chronicled in the feature film Marvel's Thor: The Dark World, Coulson and the agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. pick up the pieces–one of which threatens to destroy a member of the team.
Coulson and his team are haunted by a ghost that threatens to destroy them all, and only a secret from May's past can save them.

In a shocking cliffhanger episode, Coulson takes the war back to Centipede, and this time he brings in Michael Peterson for some super-soldier support. As they get closer to the truth, startling secrets are revealed and an unexpected twist threatens the team.

S.H.I.E.L.D. organizes a full scale hunt for Coulson. Meanwhile, Coulson uncovers vital information about the mystery of his death, but, with Centipede out for blood, this knowledge may come at the cost of one of the team!
Coulson and May uncover startling information about Skye's past, while the team is swept into a storm at a S.H.I.E.L.D. Academy of Science and Technology.
Hot on the trail of The Clairvoyant, Coulson and his team board a mystery train that seems to be headed for certain death.
Coulson goes on the attack to save Skye by enlisting the aid of Ward's former S.O. John Garrett and uncovers shocking truths about his own life and S.H.I.E.L.D.
When Coulson and his team are attacked by Lorelei - a deadly seductress who escaped from Asgard - Thor’s Lady Sif, her longtime nemesis, steps in to try to save them.
Agents Garrett and Triplett are back to help Coulson's Team track down S.H.I.E.L.D.'s nefarious enemy--The Clairvoyant. But will Deathlok destroy them all to protect his master's identity?
Coulson and his team find themselves without anyone they can trust, only to discover that they are trapped with a traitor in their midst.

With Colonel Glenn Talbot now on their trail, Coulson and his team seek refuge in the last place anyone would look, where they begin to uncover S.H.I.E.L.D.'s most dangerous secrets. Secrets that could destroy them all.

eps.n: The Only Light in the Darkness

Just when there's no one left to trust, Agent Maria Hill returns to team up with Coulson as S.H.I.E.L.D. is being destroyed around them.
Ward's betrayal and HYDRA's shocking secrets are revealed as Coulson's team goes undercover on a mission that leaves no one unscathed.
Dark secrets are revealed as Coulson and his team put everything on the line to stop Garrett and the forces of HYDRA.

Coulson and his team are now wanted fugitives with limited resources, but that's not stopping them from keeping the world safe from powerful and unseen threats everywhere. However, with new members they hardly know, will S.H.I.E.L.D. ever be trusted again?

Hunted and running out of solutions, Phil Coulson puts his team right in the line of fire in the hopes of saving them all. Coulson and his team race against HYDRA to get to Donnie Gill--a dangerous gifted with the ability to freeze objects--while Simmons is caught in the crossfire.

While on a mission to learn more about the secrets of the mysterious writing, Coulson finds himself attacked by the only person he can trust: Agent Melinda May. Meanwhile, the rest of the team is trapped in an explosive situation, and it's up to Fitz to save them--but is he up to it?

eps.n: A Hen in the Wolf House
eps.o: Coulson's team is up against the beautiful and deadly Bobbi Morse--Security Chief for HYDRA. Meanwhile, Skye's father forces Raina to reunite him with his daughter at any cost.
The world turns against S.H.I.E.L.D. when HYDRA impersonates them to attack The United Nations, and an unexpected enemy leads the charge to bring about their downfall.
The team discovers murder victims with the alien glyphs on them that Coulson's been etching. All of Coulson's secrets and lies come to a head.
Coulson and team find themselves in an epic face-off against HYDRA to uncover an ancient secret, while Ward kidnaps his brother, Senator Christian Ward, for a violent trip down memory lane.

S.H.I.E.L.D. discovers the ancient city before HYDRA, but uncovering the secrets may require one of Coulson's team to make the ultimate sacrifice. Meanwhile, Melinda May and Skye race to get to Raina before Daniel Whitehall takes her.
Coulson and Whitehall's forces meet in an explosive confrontation that dramatically alters everyone's fates. Meanwhile, Skye discovers shocking secrets about her past.

Coulson's team must deal with the consequences of their war with HYDRA as shocking revelations threaten to tear them apart, and HYDRA makes a dangerous move that may involve a traitor in S.H.I.E.L.D.'s midst.

Coulson and his team come to the aid of a confused Lady Sif, who has lost her memory after fighting with a mysterious warrior whose mission will send shockwaves through S.H.I.E.L.D. Meanwhile, Bobbi and Mack continue to hide their true mission from everyone close to them.

Cal seeks revenge on Coulson by assembling a team of Super Villains to destroy S.H.I.E.L.D. Meanwhile, May calls on renowned Dr. Andrew Garner, her charismatic ex-husband, with a crisis that threatens to tear the team apart.

eps.n: Love in the Time of Hydra
eps.o: Coulson and his team are still reeling from a shocking revelation that leaves the team fractured as they must decide what to do with one of their own. Meanwhile, Bobbi and Mack reveal their true allegiance to Hunter, while elsewhere, Ward and Agent 33 embark on a personal mission.

War comes to Coulson's doorstep in a way he never anticipated as shocking revelations are brought to light, and Skye struggles to control her new abilities but will soon make a decision that irrevocably changes her life.

As Robert Gonzales makes his move, Coulson must do whatever it takes to protect the future of S.H.I.E.L.D. Meanwhile Skye’s journey to control her powers takes a surprising turn when she meets the enigmatic Inhuman named Lincoln.

The story of Melinda May’s transformation into “The Cavalry” is revealed as she finds herself at a crossroads in the war between Coulson and Gonzales. As Skye learns more about her true heritage from Lincoln, the truth about the Inhumans will send her in a new direction.

A dangerous new alliance is formed as Coulson and Hunter turn to the last person anyone would expect – Grant Ward! As the war between S.H.I.E.L.D. factions continues, Skye and Lincoln will find themselves drawn into this conflict.
Gonzales and Coulson must find a way to put their differences aside and work together against HYDRA, even if it means teaming up with someone they don't trust.

Skye is torn between her loyalty to S.H.I.E.L.D. and her connection to the Inhumans as tensions rise between the groups -- and Coulson reveals a secret he's been hiding from even those closest to him.

S.H.I.E.L.D. puts everything on the line to survive a war that blurs the line between friend and foe. Coulson and his team will be forced to make shocking sacrifices that will leave their relationships and their world changed forever.

When a new Inhuman is discovered, Coulson and the team have an encounter with another organization seeking powered people; Fitz goes to extreme measures to determine how to get Simmons back.
Fitz and the team enlist the aid of an Asgardian to unlock the secrets of the ancient Monolith that swallowed Simmons, and Agent May is at a crossroads in her personal and professional life.

Daisy, Mack and Coulson race to protect Lincoln as Rosalind’s team hunts down the Inhuman in their quest for powered people. Meanwhile, Hunter proves that there is no line that he will not cross to exact his revenge against Ward and HYDRA.
Coulson and the team search for the Inhuman who is killing other Inhumans. Meanwhile, May feels that Hunter's mission to take down Ward is getting too personal.
After her dramatic rescue from another planet, Simmons is still reeling from her ordeal and reveals how she had to fight for her life in a harsh new world.
The stakes get even higher as Hunter and May continue to go after Ward and HYDRA, and Daisy and Coulson begin to suspect that the ATCU may be keeping a big secret from S.H.I.E.L.D.

As Daisy and the team fight to protect Inhumans, S.H.I.E.L.D. discovers the shocking truth about one of their foes; Fitz helps Simmons recover information that could lead them back through the portal.
The S.H.I.E.L.D. team discovers dangerous truths about the ATCU, and Ward's plans to destroy S.H.I.E.L.D. take a surprising twist.
Ward's campaign for revenge brings the S.H.I.E.L.D. team to their knees, and Coulson proves he will do anything to settle the score.
S.H.I.E.L.D battles HYDRA head-to-head, which sees Coulson and Fitz take the ultimate risk while Daisy and the Inhumans try to keep HYDRA at bay.

In the aftermath of his trip to Maveth, Coulson is more determined than ever to get to Gideon Malick and put an end to HYDRA once and for all. Daisy and the team encounter more Inhumans who have powers like they've never seen before, but will they be friends or enemies of S.H.I.E.L.D.?

Coulson and General Talbot are forced to team up and attend a worldwide symposium on Inhumans, where they suspect Malick has an inside man. As the S.H.I.E.L.D. team gets closer to the truth, an unexpected traitor is revealed.
Bobbi and Hunter become ensnared in an assassination plot after tracking Malick to Russia. As S.H.I.E.L.D. races to save the lives on the line, the team is changed forever.

When a radical group called The Watchdogs emerges with plans to eliminate the Inhumans, Agent Mack and his brother become caught in the crossfire. Meanwhile, Simmons discovers a powerful chemical compound that could alter the future for Inhumans.
When Daisy gets a horrifying glimpse of the future, S.H.I.E.L.D. races to prove that fate is not fixed.
S.H.I.E.L.D. hunts for information on their dangerous new enemy, and a shameful secret from Malick's past is exposed, threatening to destroy his HYDRA legacy.

Agent Daisy Johnson must call upon the Secret Warriors for an inaugural mission that will leave no member unscathed, and S.H.I.E.L.D. learns more about Hive's powers, forcing them to question everyone they trust.

The S.H.I.E.L.D. team is left reeling and decimated as Hive continues to sway Inhumans to his side. But there is a sliver of hope as Agents Fitz and Simmons follow a lead that may be able to stop the maniacal Inhuman once and for all.
Coulson and his team race to combat Hive's control over the Inhumans, as their enemy's deadly plan for the human race is revealed.

In the aftermath of the events of Captain America: Civil War, S.H.I.E.L.D. feels pressure to reveal their involvement with Inhumans. But with the stakes higher than ever and Hive growing stronger, the team is tested in ways they could never anticipate.
S.H.I.E.L.D. takes on Hive, and when his master plan is finally revealed, the team must spring into action.
